jobs.notes: Scheme opens 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027; the Law Society publishes two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm AEST) with each participating firm choosing one, so a single scheme-wide close date cannot be confirmed — offers can be made from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, and eligibility is normally penultimate year of your law degree.
